items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: And I’d taken a train from Oakland, California to Bloomington, Indiana and so I go in there and all I remember is Conte said, “Oh you’re Jake’s kid.”

ctx.x: I was 17 years old and it was interesting because in the earlier camps there were more older guys than high school guys so I was one of the younger guys and I think I made lead in about the third band out of twelve or something, you know, but Don Jacoby had been to my school and done a clinic at my high school. And he talked me into going to the camp but that summer he had a gum infection and he couldn’t go so he called Conte Candoli and Jimmy Maxwell and said, “I want you to look out for my kid Mike.” So I get…
So when you came — I’m sorry, go ahead.
